subject: Mutual commitment: Onboarding & canary schedule for Crescent Diagnostics
messages:
From: Elena Morris <elena@crescentdx.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: RE: signature completed — initial onboarding asks

Hi Vivek —

Thanks again — signatures executed this morning and legal sent the fully executed SOW. We discussed a condensed onboarding rhythm with our CTO and engineering lead; they asked for a single mutual plan (one doc) that embeds a canary window, migration approach for historical embeddings, and the training schedule for our product and dev teams.

I attached a quick internal outline (we'll drop a formal MAP into your Drive once you share a skeleton). High-level asks from Crescent:
- Production canary in a limited region (west-us) for 10 business days before full cutover
- Migration of 18 months of embeddings with a non-disruptive backfill path
- Two-day train-the-trainer session + weekly office hours for 6 weeks
- Acceptance criteria: 95th pctl latency < 250ms for generation, embedding error rate < 0.1%, and no more than 0.5% degraded responses during canary

Can you propose owners, concrete dates, and the rollout gating criteria? We prefer a December kickoff if possible.

Thanks — happy to jump on a 30-min call if helpful.

Best,
Elena
Elena Morris
Head of Integrations, Crescent Diagnostics
[Attachment: Crescent_internal_plan_outline.pdf (pdf)]

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morris <elena@crescentdx.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 11:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: RE: signature completed — initial onboarding asks

Elena —

Big congrats on getting the SOW across the finish line. Below is a proposed mutual commitment plan (MAP) skeleton we can convert to a shared spreadsheet and attach to the contract folder. I included owners and proposed dates to hit a December window. Please flag if any dates are infeasible.

1) Kickoff & discovery
- Owner: Vivek (Sales) / Marissa (CS lead)
- Date: Dec 6, 2026 — 90-min kickoff (objectives, environment access, roles)

2) Environment build & baseline testing (staging)
- Owner: Karthik (Infra) / Crescent infra lead
- Window: Dec 7–Dec 14, 2026
- Deliverables: VPC peering, model access keys, baseline latency/throughput report in staging
- Gating: staging end-to-end tests green (runbook INF-5732)

3) Canary rollout (limited region)
- Owner: Marissa (Implementation) / Crescent SRE
- Canary window: Dec 15–Dec 28, 2026 (10 business days within this window)
- Traffic plan: 5% initial traffic -> 25% after day 3 if metrics stable -> full traffic on successful completion
- Acceptance criteria: 95th pctl gen latency < 250ms, embedding error rate < 0.1%, no customer-facing degradations
- Rollback: automatic routing back to previous runtime; immediate paged alert to on-call

4) Data migration & backfill
- Owner: Crescent data engineering / Karthik (Redwood infra support)
- Approach: incremental backfill using the migration worker + prefix-based cache warm-up; low-priority workers run during night windows to limit cost
- Window: Dec 20, 2026 — Jan 10, 2027 (parallel with tail of canary)
- Validation: sampling checksums + reconciliation job (see INF-5732)

5) Training & enablement
- Owner: Marissa / Vivek
- Activities: 2-day train-the-trainer (onsite or virtual) + weekly 60-min office hours for 6 weeks starting Jan 12, 2027

6) Final cutover & hypercare
- Owner: Crescent ops / Marissa
- Target full production cutover: Jan 18, 2027 (post-migration validation)
- Hypercare: 2 weeks with increased observability and daily syncs

I'll push a MAP_v1.xlsx into the shared Drive with owner columns and gating checkboxes by EOD. Also linking INF-5732 for the migration runbook.

If this looks good, we can put the dates into the DocuSign SOW amendment and lock the kickoff.

Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Senior Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1-415-555-0198
[Attachment: MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 08:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Mutual commitment: Onboarding & canary schedule for Crescent Diagnostics

Thanks — I added a canary checklist and a lightweight migration sanity test to the MAP spreadsheet. Key notes from implementation perspective:
- Canary checklist highlights: traffic shapers configured, KV cache warming disabled for first 24h (to observe cold-start behavior), sampling hooks enabled for degraded-response capture, and alert thresholds pre-set in the Console
- Migration sanity: run a 5k-record sample pass and validate semantic similarity thresholds (we'll provide the script) before full backfill
- Training: recommend recording both days and capturing a short playbook for internal SMEs; I'll own the recordings + office hours calendar invites

Attachments I uploaded: Crescent_Security_Responses.pdf (answers to a few SOC/retention Qs) and a short canary-run checklist. Also created a Jira epic (INF-5732) with tasks mapped to owners.

Proposed next step: 30-min kickoff Dec 6 at 10am PT. If Crescent confirms, I'll send invites and add the Drive folder with versioned MAP.

- Marissa
Marissa Cole
Implementation Manager, Redwood Inference

Marissa, Vivek —

This looks great and aligns with the internal ask. Dec 6 at 10am PT works for our team; I've reserved the slot and added our CTO. We reviewed the acceptance criteria and the canary gating — we accept the proposed thresholds with one minor tweak: please include an additional data-quality gate for embeddings (monthly drift check after cutover).

I'll sign the SOW amendment and the DocuSign link should be visible to you (I will forward once executed). For immediate next steps:
- Crescent confirms kickoff Dec 6, 10am PT
- Marissa to share calendar invites + Drive link
- Vivek to add deal id to the DocuSign amendment (RDW-2026-4821)

Looking forward to the kickoff.
